readings: For tracks with Track.Bytes less than 10,323,804, calculate each media type’s average of Track.Bytes ÷ Track.Milliseconds. Return the unrounded, unweighted average of those media-type averages as one value.

For tracks with Track.Bytes less than or equal to 10,323,804, calculate each media type’s average of Track.Bytes ÷ Track.Milliseconds. Return the unrounded, unweighted average of those media-type averages as one value.

For tracks with Track.Bytes greater than 10,323,804, calculate each media type’s average of Track.Bytes ÷ Track.Milliseconds. Return the unrounded, unweighted average of those media-type averages as one value.

For tracks with Track.Bytes greater than or equal to 10,323,804, calculate each media type’s average of Track.Bytes ÷ Track.Milliseconds. Return the unrounded, unweighted average of those media-type averages as one value.
queries:
SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes < 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes <= 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_average)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(1.0 * Bytes / Milliseconds) AS media_type_average
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes > 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)

SELECT AVG(media_type_avg)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS media_type_avg
    FROM Track
    WHERE Bytes >= 10323804
    GROUP BY MediaTypeId
)
